metadata.question: In Janaury 2020, did the city of Mahajanga experience more than 12 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: The question is about rainfall in Mahajanga, Madagascar in January 2020, specifically asking if there was more than 12 inches of rainfall. Strategy: 1. Data: Use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) which provides global rainfall estimates 2. Location: Mahajanga, Madagascar (approx lat: -15.7167, lon: 46.3167) 3. Time: January 2020 (2020-01-01 to 2020-01-31) 4. Processing: Sum daily rainfall for the month, convert from mm to inches (1 inch = 25.4 mm), so 12 inches = 304.8 mm 5. Validation: Check collection size, pixel counts, and valid rainfall values I need to: - Define a point geometry for Mahajanga with a buffer to create a region - Use CHIRPS daily precipitation data - Sum precipitation for January 2020 - Check if total > 304.8 mm - Handle potential data issues For CHIRPS, the collection is 'UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY' and the precipitation band is 'precipitation' ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const mahajanga = ee.Geometry.Point([46.3167, -15.7167]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around city const startDate = '2020-01-01'; const endDate = '2020-01-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS daily precipitation const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(mahajanga); const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`January 2020 rainfall images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum monthly precipitation const monthlyRainfall = chirps.sum(); // Check pixel count const pixelCount = monthlyRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: mahajanga, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean rainfall in mm const rainfallMm = monthlyRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: mahajanga, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Total rainfall (mm): ${rainfallMm ? rainfallMm.toFixed(1) : 'null'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (rainfallMm === null || rainfallMm === undefined || isNaN(rainfallMm) || rainfallMm < 0) { console.log("C3"); } else { const rainfallInches = rainfallMm / 25.4; console.log(`Total rainfall (inches): ${rainfallInches.toFixed(1)}`); if (rainfallInches > 12) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
